study.question: Observed limitation: r0029 rotated all five summary action inputs together. Aligned-minus-rotated click AUC was 0.0030446242 for task routing and 0.0034193522 for shared routing; their difference -0.0003747280 is small and single-seed. Which part of this conditional alignment loss depends on target-match versus ordinal summary action channels, do those families interact, and does routing modify those contrasts?
study.hypothesis: The all-family rotation loss may be driven mainly by action alignment in target-match directions, by within-block order alignment, or by their joint use. Complete the match-rotation x ordinal-rotation factorial at each routing using four off-diagonal cells and verified existing endpoints. This is a falsifiable localization hypothesis, not an assumption that either family or task conditioning must win. Original feedback masks and observed direct pools remain fixed.

study.proposed_difference: Only _represent passes a second, aligned summary stream; _target_match_summary additionally contracts that stream with unchanged coefficients and normalizes identically. A new nonlearned selector chooses rotated versus aligned action coordinates by summary family; item coordinates retain the inherited contraction. predictions: If target-match alignment dominates, rotating rows0/4 alone reduces click AUC versus aligned endpoints and recovers most of the all-family loss; ordinal-only rotation is smaller. The converse supports an ordinal-dominant account. No ordering is assumed for mixed cells.

With A_mo(r) denoting click AUC for match rotation m, ordinal rotation o and routing r, report L_match=A00-A10, L_ordinal=A00-A01, joint loss=A00-A11 and interaction I=A00-A10-A01+A11. Positive I means the sum of isolated losses exceeds the joint loss; negative I means joint damage exceeds their sum. Report each contrast separately for task/shared and task-minus-shared contrast differences.

Predeclare0.0005 absolute click-AUC as a practical effect size for family losses and interaction, not a significance threshold. Report continuous estimates even below it. Current r0029 routing modification of joint loss is -0.0003747280 and does not meet this practical threshold.

Same-state changes are confined to selected summary action coordinates. Empty/singleton blocks and homogeneous-action blocks are identities. Coarse-linear/quadratic action moments are invariant in exact arithmetic; host must quantify numerical residuals. This does not predict equal empty-history scores after separately trained models diverge.

Host reports full-population click AUC and unweighted Logloss, all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, parameters, allocated GPU/wall seconds, examples processed, peak memory and inference throughput/p50/p95 latency. Reuse fixed history bins0,1-16,17-64,>64 with sample/positive/negative counts; other slices require authorized existing scorers and training-defined/predeclared bins, otherwise mark unavailable. Use paired user-cluster bootstrap only through authorized host support; otherwise intervals unavailable.
falsifiers: A near-zero loss for rotating one family weakens that family-specific alignment account; a near-zero joint loss on repetition weakens the previous alignment account. Better perturbed performance is valid counterevidence, not an execution failure.
No practically consequential or repeated task-minus-shared contrast difference weakens routing-dependence claims. One seed cannot establish a mechanism, even with a paired population interval.

Failed mask/ownership/finite-value checks, changed item summaries or scorer/direct-pool inputs at common state, incorrect family selection, or failure of endpoint gradient/optimizer bridges invalidates factorial attribution. Missing checks are missing evidence, not scientific refutation.

If apparent gains/losses are explained by coarse-moment BF16 leakage, changed optimizer behavior, effective capacity or unmatched recipe, do not attribute them to action alignment. If all perturbations are identities on actual inputs, the probe is uninformative.
alternative_explanations: Action embedding row usage, gradient cancellation, numerical precision and one-pass optimization can mediate effects without proving irreducible feedback information.

Retain that check cost; no training was attempted. Read-only evidence is untouched; no writable memory API is exposed in this phase, so evidence-linked observations and revisions are preserved in this proposal for the host study archive.
